newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eramet sees 1997 H1 net as high as in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Eramet sees 1997 H1 net as high as in 1996.

text.p: French nickel group Eramet expects 1997 first half net profit to be at least as high as the level in the first half of 1996, Eramet chairman Yves Rambaud told a shareholders meeting on Thursday.

"In the first half, the 46 percent stake in Comilog will be consolidated in proportion to the stake held. On this basis the net profit for the group will be up compared with the second half of 1996 and should be at least equal to the first half of 1996 which did not take Comilog into account," he said.
Eramet has since raised its stake in Comilog to 61 percent, Rambaud said.
